a1c7c817-4e59-43b7-9365-09675a149a6f.title: One Piece
a1c7c817-4e59-43b7-9365-09675a149a6f.description:
From Viz:
As a child, Monkey D. Luffy was inspired to become a pirate by listening to the tales of "Red-Haired" Shanks. But his life changed when Luffy accidentally ate the Gum-Gum Devil Fruit and gained the power to stretch like rubber at the cost of never being able to swim again. Years later, still vowing to become the king of the pirates, Luffy sets out on his adventure one guy alone in a rowboat, in search of the legendary "One Piece," said to be the greatest treasure in the world.

The best-selling manga in history and tied with Superman for the best-selling comics in history.

---

**Note:**  
**Because a takedown notice was sent to MangaDex from the owners of this series, English fan translations of One Piece are unable to be posted at this time. The series can be read in its entirety at [the official Shonen Jump website,](https://www.viz.com/shonenjump/chapters/one-piece) with the first and latest three chapters available at any time and the rest accessible with a Shonen Jump membership (which costs about $2 a month and can be accessed via a VPN if you are outside the US). The three most recent chapters can also be read on MangaPlus for free by clicking the chapter links below.**

---
- **The Best-Selling Manga in History**
- **Won the 41st Japan Cartoonists Association Award Grand Prize alongside Neko Darake in 2012** 
- **Received the Kumamoto Prefecture Honorary Prize in 2018**

2356f5ff-143f-4e3b-96e6-9d9f5efab8c5.title: Ningen Fushin no Boukenshatachi ga Sekai o Sukuu Youdesu
2356f5ff-143f-4e3b-96e6-9d9f5efab8c5.altTitle: Adventurers Who Don't Believe in Humanity Will Save the World
2356f5ff-143f-4e3b-96e6-9d9f5efab8c5.description: Life isn’t going well for veteran adventurer Nick. Despite his loyalty to his party, he was betrayed by a teammate who accused him of embezzlement, then kicked out by his mentor. On top of that, his girlfriend dumped him too! Tired, heartbroken, and looking for a drink, Nick chances upon a few kindred spirits who are as jaded as he is. Can these disillusioned heroes put their faith in each other long enough to save the world together…?

d579c665-7cdb-4c5f-9370-942231fd35bc.title: Sanju Mariko
d579c665-7cdb-4c5f-9370-942231fd35bc.description:
The manga centers on veteran novelist Mariko Kōda, who lives with the families of both her son and her grandson in one house. Feeling like she no longer has any place in her home, she decides to leave the house and strike out on her own, beginning with living in a manga cafe in the city.

Won 42nd Annual Kodansha Manga Award for "Best General Manga" (2018)

bc70eee3-5668-4a89-bc57-4ec3af33e8ed.title: Kyou kara Onushi wa Warawa no Musuko
bc70eee3-5668-4a89-bc57-4ec3af33e8ed.altTitle: From Today, You are the Snake Goddess' Son
bc70eee3-5668-4a89-bc57-4ec3af33e8ed.description: It's the present day. A small boy, abandoned at a shrine by his mother, is taken in and lovingly raised by a serpent god who has adored raising children since ancient times. However, being a non-human deity, the serpent god’s affection seems to be just a little... off the mark?

chapters.title: Something Something Until We Get Home!!

41c40654-fb7e-4cae-9796-79731118f819.title: Illeston Jeotaeg ui 100-gaji Jeoju
41c40654-fb7e-4cae-9796-79731118f819.description:
**Even if it’s a cursed mansion, it’s the only place for me to live!**

As if being reincarnated into a generic fantasy webtoon wasn’t enough, I have to be the ‘Necromancer’ who is sacrificed for the protagonist...

Since it has come to this, it can’t be helped. Even if I can’t become a rich noble lady from a romance fantasy, I want to at least protect my life and live comfortably.

Let’s go to that place, the one full of curses and ghost stories. To the mansion of the villain, Archduke Illestone!

**"I will break the curse on this mansion for you, In return, please raise me."**

315d9d7d-6875-4e48-ab96-fbb7b9c8f3f2.title: Kounai Sandai Bijo no Himo Shitemasu
315d9d7d-6875-4e48-ab96-fbb7b9c8f3f2.altTitle: I’m a Kept Man for the Three Most Beautiful Girls in School
315d9d7d-6875-4e48-ab96-fbb7b9c8f3f2.description:
The “Three School Beauties” everyone admires—Karasumaru Kage, Ono Tsukasa, and Daigo Sakurako. For a poor, lonely guy like me, Kyousaka Kei, they were supposed to be out of my league… until I saved them from a potential assault and they became intensely fond of me.
“I want to get closer to you, even just a little. I want to know more about you, Kyousaka.”
Then, they asked me to do a part-time job fulfilling their requests. I thought it would be simple errands, but things gradually escalated…
“Hey, hug me tight.”
“Wanna kiss?”
“Touch me there. Harder.”
And it’s all because— “““It’s okay, it’s part of the job.”””
A lovey-dovey life at 5,000 yen per hour… Is this… being a kept man?
“Yes. We want to take care of you, Kei-kun.”
Tempted by 3 Beautiful Girls—Even Cuddling is Part of a Kept Man’s Job.

bb1cb2cf-b733-4fa4-a327-05887ec1564d.title: Brocken Blood
bb1cb2cf-b733-4fa4-a327-05887ec1564d.description:
"I'll create a witch!!"

During the 17th century, the German alchemist Johann Schultz successfully created a witch. He then injected that power into his own blood. In the present day, as a result of a scheme created by his cousin, Yomoda Rena, Shurutsu Kenichi, a high school student and a third generation German, fights on secretly as a blood relative of "Brocken", all in order to hunt down those who abuse the artificial witch theorem. Yet for reasons unknown, he transforms into a Magical Girl "Heroine"...?

2cce0dee-b4e9-45c5-a02c-b70ac195ad56.title: Majo no Hanaya-san
2cce0dee-b4e9-45c5-a02c-b70ac195ad56.description: Allie Abel, a girl who came from the countryside wishing to become a witch who can make people happy with magic, meets Yoshino-York, an unusual witch who sells ordinary flowers and believes that "people can be happy without relying on magic". Allie, who has been assigned to work at Yoshino's florist as an apprentice witch, is now making "happiness" that was supposed to come true through magic come true with her own hands...?

49ccb19e-34e9-40d4-a53e-cdb48360b351.title: This Life's Universal Superstar
49ccb19e-34e9-40d4-a53e-cdb48360b351.altTitle: I'm Going to Be a Big Star
49ccb19e-34e9-40d4-a53e-cdb48360b351.description: Hard-pressed to find good luck in this universe, Sun Woojoo gives up on his dream of becoming an idol in favor of living a normal life. That is, until he finds himself waking up from a car accident on his exam day! But as luck would have it, Woojoo can now copy any move exactly as he sees it, and his two left feet that kept him from debuting are now moving to the beat! With this newfound skill, will Woojoo be able to turn things around and become the star that shines the brightest on stage?
